turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on there is and there are?
turns.tutor:
Look: There is a book. There are two books. One book: is. Two books: are.
The rule: use there is for one thing and there are for two or more.
Right: There are four chairs. Wrong: There is four chairs.
Your turn. Complete: "___ three windows in my room."
